The purpose of this paper is to examine factors that patients identify as important in the planning of health human resources for primary care.

Patients identified three themes that are relevant to the health human resource (HHR) plan for primary healthcare ( PHC ): (a) the need to overcome geographic barriers, (b) the need for better change management at the level of the practice, and (c) that the system should provide support structures to allow primary care providers (PCPs) to work closer to the full scope of their practice.
the public is concerned about the lack of health human resources in rural and remote communities, and the lack of access to a family physician in urban areas.
